title: PIR Status Sidecar
description: Machine-readable Priority Intelligence Requirement (PIR) status sidecar produced by every agentic analysis cycle. Written to `analysis/daily/YYYY-MM-DD/{subfolder}/pir-status.json`. Enables automated PIR roll-forward, cross-cycle gap detection, and CI gate enforcement. Schema v1.0.

schema_version.description: Schema version — always '1.0' for this release.

cycle.description: Analysis cycle type slug (matches the subfolder name convention).

date.description: ISO calendar date of this analysis run (YYYY-MM-DD).

subfolder.description: Relative subfolder path under `analysis/daily/YYYY-MM-DD/` — must equal the `cycle` value.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this sidecar was generated (UTC).

inherited_from.description: Source path this file was rolled forward from, e.g. `analysis/daily/2026-04-26/month-ahead/pir-status.json`. Null when this is a freshly authored set (no roll-forward).

pirs.description: Ordered list of PIRs for this cycle. May be empty for short-event cycles that did not define standing PIRs.

pir_id.description: Stable local identifier within this cycle, e.g. 'PIR-1', 'PIR-A', 'PIR-FiU-1'. Must be unique within the `pirs` array.

statement.description: Human-readable intelligence requirement statement. Must be specific, falsifiable, and actionable.

trigger.description: Observable event or threshold that would answer / close this PIR. Optional but strongly recommended.

confidence.description: ODNI-aligned confidence label on the current status assessment.

answer_summary.description: Short (≤ 500 chars) summary of the evidence or event that answered this PIR. Populate only when status='answered'.

inherits_from.description: Zero or more `pir_id` references from the previous cycle that this PIR continues or inherits from.

evidence_refs.description: Riksdag `dok_id` references, primary-source URLs, or named artifacts that provide evidence for the current status assessment. At least one reference is recommended for answered PIRs.

horizon.description: Monitoring horizon for this PIR, expressed as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a relative label ('next-session', 'next-week', 'election-day'). Optional.

admiralty_grade.description: Admiralty Code grade of the best available source for the current status (STANAG 2022). Source reliability A–F + information credibility 1–6.
